atoms.text: This is Selena and her neighbour Mr Parker. Sometimes Mr Parker uses sayings incorrectly. Can you help Selena correct him?

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps with the correct word.

atoms.b: Good morning, Selena! The early bird catches the cat.
Oh Mr Parker, the early bird catches the ((++worm boy dog)), not the cat!
Oh you’re right, you’re right. Now listen, you shouldn’t be too sad that your girlfriend moved away. Absence makes the heart closer, you know.
Mr Parker! Absence makes the heart grow ((colder ++fonder darker)), not closer! I do miss her, but there’s no point in crying over spilled ((tea chocolate ++milk)). I will get to visit her very soon.
I’m happy to hear that you’re not too sad. Plus, you have pictures of the two of you together and a picture is worth...How does that saying go again?
